notes: Posted 11 November 2001, before Theed Palace, so the format is Premiere - Reflections III. The author says no Reflections III cards are used (a 'NO REFLECTIONS III' contest).

Starting (7) as posted: No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?, Tatooine: Watto's Junkyard, Tatooine: Mos Espa, Prepared Defenses and the three Effects it deploys: You Cannot Hide Forever & Mobilization Points, Something Special Planned For Them and Do They Have A Code Clearance?; these count toward the total.
The list totals 59 as published (section headers 7+21+1+4+15+3+8); kept as posted.
Posted 'Do They Have A Code Clearance' dested the Coruscant Effect Do They Have A Code Clearance? (starting Effect; the author uses no Reflections III cards, so not the Defensive Shield).
Posted 'Captain Godhert' dested Captain Godherdt; 'Vader's Obssession' Vader's Obsession; 'Slave 1' Slave I; 'Boba Fett' the Cloud City Boba Fett.

Systems posted without a side dested the Dark printings: Yavin 4 (Dark), Sullust (Dark), Kashyyyk (Dark), Mon Calamari (Dark), Endor (Dark), Tatooine: Mos Espa Docking Bay (Dark); 'Tatooine' dested Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere) (the post does not say Premiere or Coruscant printing); 'Heavy Turbolaser Battery' dested Heavy Turbolaser Battery (Dark).
The byline 'Darth Vader "The Dark" Lord of The Sith' is a prank name; the deck is credited to the DeckTech handle The Dark as plain text (no player page), as with decks 19842, 20080 and 20227.
The strategy says the author expects to play it at FreedomCon 2001 (a side tournament with friends); no result is given.
